dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あと３日で授業も終わりだけど、気〜抜かん
　ようにな。その後は卒業パーティーの準備も
　あるし……じゃあ号令」
dialogues.en:
"There's just 3 more days to the end of lessons, so keep
your spirits up for the preparations for the graduation
party."
dialogues.text:
"There's just 3 more days to the end of lessons, so keep
your spirits up for the preparations for the graduation
party."

dialogues.jp: 週番の声が響き、ＨＲが終わる。
dialogues.en:
With the weekly cleanup duty echoing throughout the room, HR
ended.
dialogues.text:
With the weekly cleanup duty echoing throughout the room, HR
ended.

dialogues.jp:
あんま、思い出どうこうという気にはならんな。
どうせまた、同じ学園に通うんだし。
dialogues.en:
I didn't have that many memories of the school life here...
but I'd have another three years to make more anyway.
dialogues.text:
I didn't have that many memories of the school life here...
but I'd have another three years to make more anyway.

dialogues.en: "(Well, I'd just enjoy the break while I can.)"
dialogues.text: "(Well, I'd just enjoy the break while I can.)"

dialogues.jp:
まずは、今日のかったるい授業をやり過ごさな
いとな。机に手を突っ込み、教科書の確認をす
る。
dialogues.en:
I just wish today's lessons would go faster... I lay my hand
lazily on my desk, as I ready my textbook.
dialogues.text:
I just wish today's lessons would go faster... I lay my hand
lazily on my desk, as I ready my textbook.

dialogues.jp:
授業は、今日を入れても残り三日。卒パ準備期
間の後には、いよいよ卒業が待っている。
dialogues.en:
Only three days of lessons left, including today. The
remainder of the school year would be spent on preparations
for the graduation party, and waiting for the graduation
itself.
dialogues.text:
Only three days of lessons left, including today. The
remainder of the school year would be spent on preparations
for the graduation party, and waiting for the graduation
itself.

dialogues.jp:
とは言ってもなぁ……別に付属から本校に行く
にしても女子のように制服が一新されるわけで
もないし、特に感慨は無いよなぁ。
dialogues.en:
Really though... besides seeing all the girls in a new
school uniform, I don't have any strong feelings towards
moving to the main school either way.
dialogues.text:
Really though... besides seeing all the girls in a new
school uniform, I don't have any strong feelings towards
moving to the main school either way.
